coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The public portal and its current JavaScript/configuration were fetched. Archive/property endpoints require authorization, and no anonymous parcel feature service, schema, CRS, or safe ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

technicalBlocker: The portal config at https://www.gybdcwx.cn/config.js uses the /declaration API base. TLS-verified POST /declaration/system/crypto/config returned {enabled:false}; unauthenticated GET /declaration/bdc-affix/user-houses returned HTTP 401, and unauthenticated POST /declaration/wyc/getArchivesFileQuery with an empty body returned HTTP 401. The public frontend JavaScript exposes archive/property workflow routes but no public parcel geometry layer. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe owner/address query was used.
